body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 13aee143afd108e10e62b22c3ce845d3ebbb63f9 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge**

Thanks, austin62jake - tidy, well-pinned fix.

**What looks good**
- `Tool::tip_corner_r` (crates/tools/src/tools.rs) states the ball/probe rule once; the editor, `to_tool` and the library summary all read it, so the saved document holds the radius that is cut.
- The ball-nose editor shows the corner as read-only text; bull nose still edits it, and the new tests guard both sides.
- No unwrap/expect/panic outside tests, no new components, layering intact (ui only reads `Tool`), no dependency/build.rs/.github/script changes, provenance line on the new test module, decision record at docs/decisions/263-ball-corner.md, body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #N`, no CHANGELOG.md edit. Tool edits still go through the existing Apply -> command path, unchanged.

**Local results (Windows, PR trial-merged with current origin/main - merged cleanly, no conflicts)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-tools --lib` | 8 passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (CWD crates/ui, includes `tool_editor_snapshot` and the shell snapshots) | 266 passed, 2 ignored |
| the 4 new `ball_corner_tests` | 4 passed |
| ui `--test operations` / `shell` / `egui_app` | 31 / 19 / 3 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-tools -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

No snapshot changes in the PR and none needed regeneration here (the pixel failures the author saw on their machine did not occur on current main).

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `state.rs` (3674 lines) and `pages.rs` (1896) are far over ~400 lines; this PR adds ~13 and ~7 - growth only, not blocking.
- A Probe is also saved with `corner_r = d/2` (via `tip_corner_r`) but the editor still shows its corner as an editable field; consider showing it read-only too, as a follow-up.
- Not run on Linux/macOS and the windowed app was not opened by hand (as the body says); the kittest tests draw the real editor code.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
